name: Soleil -Première-
source:
Keito is appointed as the manager of a small youkan named Shichiyoutei in Shinkawa-chou. He is greeted by three maids Yurika, Ayumi and Fimnet, all with different personalities. It is said that kindness changes people and so their calm and quiet days begin.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
